thread:
anya: FYI the gpu nodepool 'west1-gpu-batch' started failing scheduling overnight. Nodes spin, pods pending with no IP.
raj: Which subnet/secondary range are we using?
anya: redwood-prod-west1-subnet, secondary range name 'pods-west1-02' currently /24 (256 IPs). Nodepool scaled to 18 nodes, kubelet maxPods=110. Observed ~680 pod IPs allocated to this range.
marta: That math doesn't add up, GKE reserves some IPs per node. Also check if there are other clusters sharing that secondary range.
sam: Short term: create a temp nodepool with a different secondary range or add an alias range to the subnet.
anya: Spun up 'west1-gpu-temp' nodepool and cordoned a few nodes. Moving lower-priority batch jobs there now.
infra-bot: Commands to inspect:
```
# show subnet ranges
gcloud compute networks subnets describe redwood-prod-west1-subnet --region=west1 --project=redwood-prod-west1 --format="yaml(secondaryIpRanges)"
# show nodecounts
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -A -o wide
```
raj: I'm drafting a GCP quota/support request. Proposal:
- Expand secondary range 'pods-west1-02' from /24 -> /22
- Increase A100-80GB regional quota from 24 -> 96
- Request regional accelerator quota (not zonal) if possible
gcp-sales: If you include forecasted node counts and expected spend we can flag for expedited review.
raj: Filed SR# SR-2026-0999 and attached CSV with node/pod counts and 12-week forecast. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2399900
marta: Also include cluster name, nodepool config, and list of daemonsets (they consume hostIPs). That speeds approval.
sam: Long-term: consider /20 for the VPC if growth continues, and evaluating IP-per-pod alternatives (IPv6, CNI custom routes) to reduce pressure.
infra: Action items: raj follow SR; anya validate migration; sam run daemonset audit; infra prepare subnet expansion playbook.
anya: Marking P0. I'll post updates when SR moves.
raj: GCP acked receipt and asked for exact subnet CIDR and current allocation CSV (uploading now). They asked for 48-72h review window.
infra-bot: Reminder: when expanding secondary range, control-plane compatibility check needed (no nodepool disruption if ranges added correctly).
marta: Good work. Keep thread short updates only. :thumbsup:
